original_test_intent: Boot the selected SUT into its approved pre-OS UEFI Shell, execute the exact `ver` command, and compare the complete reported UEFI firmware version with the project specification.
original_method: Record identity/boot baseline, select the approved UEFI Shell, run only `ver`, capture its complete output and console context, compare against the supplied version, exit without writes, and restore normal OS boot.
manual_activity: A human must select the pre-OS shell, enter `ver` and observe/capture its output. OS SSH cannot perform or prove this shell interaction.
required_inputs: Expected UEFI firmware version and formatting rule
safety_requirements: Approve any boot-path/order change and drain workloads.
Run only the read-only `ver` command; do not explore or write through other shell commands.
Verify shell media identity and avoid unapproved storage access.
Stop on wrong shell, ambiguous version, boot failure or recovery loss.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only identity, boot-entry and post-return health evidence.
Parse operator-supplied complete `ver` output and compare it with the approved SPEC.
Inspect the existing script for exact shell/command behavior without claiming execution or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve expected version, shell path and recovery.
Boot the shell, run/capture exact `ver`, and restore normal boot.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its manual boundary is correct, but the source command is exactly `ver`; `version` must not be substituted without platform documentation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve `ver` in the approved UEFI Shell. Do not replace it with OS firmware queries, which do not test the shell command.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exact `ver`, script URL and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture one frame/stream containing shell identity, exact `ver` input and complete response, then record a normalized expected-to-actual version comparison.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS and shell build/version plus project-script revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner UEFI version SPEC and platform shell guide.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity, provenance, comparison and boot restoration without changing the command.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Shell version output may describe the UEFI implementation differently from a BIOS package label; mapping needs owner approval.

project_override_considerations: A project supplies the expected version and approved shell path. Those inputs make execution ready but do not permit an OS-side version command to replace the source `ver` behavior.
expected_evidence: Platform/firmware identity, expected version and approval
Shell path/media identity and pre-boot baseline
Timestamped console capture with exact `ver` and full output
Normal boot restoration, health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, command and Criteria consistently require UEFI Shell `ver`; missing expected value/path are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only purpose is clear. Missing SPEC, shell path, console or approval does not permanently block the case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with MANUAL ONLY while tightening the exact-command requirement.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its shell-path, recovery and version-comparison improvements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds explicit no-substitution and project-override limits with verdict separation.

review_improvement: Prevents an OS firmware query or undocumented command alias from being claimed as execution of the named UEFI Shell command.
independent_technical_reasoning: The test target is the interactive pre-OS shell command itself. Since entering the shell, typing and observing the result are core manual actions, MANUAL ONLY remains correct despite automatable comparison support.
no_automatic_retry: Do not reselect the shell or rerun the command automatically after mismatch; preserve the first capture and obtain engineer disposition.
